factual_accuracy_review.scope: Independent verification of every technical claim in this file against tools/aris_homepage.py source, skills/homepage-generator/SKILL.md, skills/homepage-generator/PROFILE_SCHEMA.md, and README.md's ARIS-Homepage section. Reviewer was instructed not to trust the document and to check ground truth itself (function names + line numbers required as evidence).

findings.correction: run_fact_check() (tools/aris_homepage.py ~L1373-1493) checks bibkey existence, DBLP title hit/no-hit/ambiguity, year mismatch, venue mismatch (fuzzy), and award-badge-needs-a-verifiable-URL sanity — it never checks author lists.

findings.claim: Paper action links can come from publications.bib url/eprint fields, in addition to profile.yml's publications_meta.<bibkey>.links
findings.correction: build_publications_section() (tools/aris_homepage.py ~L904-986) reads links EXCLUSIVELY from profile.yml's publications_meta.<bibkey>.links. A url/eprint field in publications.bib is valid BibTeX but is never read for rendering link buttons.

rounds.confirmed_claims_summary: Script filename/underscore, no installed aris-homepage alias, pyyaml requirement, pdftotext subprocess call + poppler-utils error message, render/check auto-audit with PASS/WARN/BLOCKED semantics (WARN non-blocking, BLOCKED blocks unless --override-all), fact-check never writing links/thumbnails back to files, identity.photo base64/URL embed with no fetching, the init→extraction.json→finalize→render pipeline and finalize's clear die() on missing extraction.json, theory-minimal valid / active-researcher hard-disabled, and that the Windows-environment claims (.py file-association silence, python3 App Execution Alias stub, pdftotext non-ASCII path mangling, urllib.request-based SSL/pip-system-certs fix) are correctly attributed as external OS/tool behavior rather than script behavior — all CONFIRMED against source.

rounds.notes: Targeted fixes for the two WRONG findings above were correct, but a lingering sentence (near the end of the '主仓库 README 演示图...' section) still told users to add missing links/thumbnails in both profile.yml AND publications.bib. Reviewer flagged this as still over-broad given the link-source finding.

Follow-up sentence tightened to point at profile.yml's publications_meta (links/thumbnail) only. Reviewer re-read both audited files fresh from disk and confirmed no remaining issue from the audited claim set.

summary: Windows PowerShell quick-start + troubleshooting guide for the ARIS-Homepage CLI, written from a real live debugging session (Python-vs-python3, .py file-association silence, non-ASCII pdftotext path mangling, pyyaml/pip-system-certs dependency fixes).
